fixture.selection: First sorted-ID current-policy-valid multi-gold question for ordinary 4D and each of the three 5D recipes; no model outcomes consulted.

public_contract.optional_fifth: Exactly one recipe ID bound to the ordered operations in recipe-menu.json
public_contract.prompt_request_parity: Both provider request builders match frozen exported messages, checked without client creation

reward.content_rule: Exactly one nonempty answer tag; NFC plus strip; membership in full accepted Devanagari union; binary 0 or 1
reward.outside_text: Current scorer accepts outside text when exactly one accepted answer tag is present; preserved, not tightened
reward.chat_normalization: Plain text or exactly one assistant message with string content and no other fields; reject other structures
reward.truncation_status: Separate provider completion accounting, not inferred by this content-only RL callback

assets.note: Physical path/schema separation, not encryption/access-control enforcement. Training/reward process can read keys; model inputs contain messages only.

split.identity: Dictionary aupadeshika plus gana, not etymological family
split.enforcement: Regenerated actual dictionary family must match the master split; metadata relabeling is rejected before gold regeneration. Dedicated training loader accepts only rl_train.
limitations: No RL corpus is generated in this task.
Master family labels alone do not prove checkpoint cleanliness. Legacy analysis inspected all families before the later reserve.
No claim that distinct dictionary entries are unrelated etymologically.

findings.detail: Existing GRPO loader reconstructs a legacy prompt and omits the 5D Sanadi recipe; it does not consume frozen prompt/messages.
Existing vp_exact gives 0.85 for correct answer-only and 0.15 for a wrong answer with valid thinking format; this is not binary benchmark reward.
Existing reward recorder concatenates chat message contents, losing role/multiplicity; new exact reward requires the isolated preserve-completion-structure option.
Existing exporter co-locates prompts, gold and task/trace metadata; isolated package separates public inputs from verifier assets.
Generic task mechanics support more recipes than the final menu. Freeze menu IDs with exact ordered operations and validate both, as demonstrated.
Current dry-run and Pass@K reconstruct legacy prompts; route these through frozen prompts and exact reward before real training. Final-test data must not become checkpoint selection data.

runtime.qualification: Prospective current installed-file provenance only, not retroactive proof of earlier runtime bytes.

remaining_deliverables: Qualify and freeze each final panel and protocol; no final N is chosen here.
Freeze current-policy task validation, exact recipe menu, source/runtime/split/render/scorer hashes and full-union private keys.
Generate an independent allowed-scope RL-family corpus and validate against the master split.
Integrate explicit frozen-prompt loader, exact reward registration/recorder option, config/dry-run and checkpoint-eval path; rerun local end-to-end checks before training.
Publish prompt-only assets separately from restricted verifier keys and traces, with a trusted release-manifest fingerprint and reproduction instructions.
